Manage outreach for KYC packets and maintain complete, accurate Salesforce records of counterparty documentation.

Maintain program metrics and reporting, and maintain Salesforce data quality and reporting within established standards.
As the Third Party Diligence program matures, responsibilities will expand to include:
Execute compliance control tests under the Compliance Operations & Risk control testing process, documenting test results and supporting evidence.
